title: Ley jaayiyeh khaimey mein yeh mashk-o-alam Maula
body:
Ley jaayiyeh khaimey mein yeh mashk-o-alam Maula
Daryaa pa huvey meray shaaney bhi qalam Maula
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai waqt mera aakher jald aaiyeh Ya Sarwar
Taa dekhloon aankhon sey Hazrat kay qadam Maula
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab waqt nahin aaqa deedaar dikhaa dijiyeh
Mushtaaq-e-Ziarath ka hai aankhon mein dam Maula
<<DIVIDER>>
Dikhlaayi nahin deitha ab aankhon sey khaadim ko
Hai aankh mein paiwasthaa ek teer-e-sitham Maula
Mehjoob Sakina sey qismath ney kiya mujhko
Pyaasi rahi Shehzadi aur margaye hum Maula
<<DIVIDER>>
Reythi pa giraa hoon maen narghey mein ghiraa hon maen
Ruk-ruk kay nikalthaa hai ab seenay sey dum Maula
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehta tha yehi rokar Saqqa-e-Haram Baqar
Hai mashk-e-Sakina ka Abbas ko gham Maula
